title: Realization commutes with the normalized restriction/direct-image cube
statement: Let A,B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B a ring homomorphism and g:Z→Y any morphism of schemes. Use the unbounded derived fixed-scalar pro-etale categories and the derived intrinsic constant-ring module categories, their realization equivalences E_TA,E_TB, the direct images Q_A,Q_B on fixed coefficients and P_A,P_B intrinsically [def-finite-compact-scalar-transport-data]. Let U_T be intrinsic derived restriction and V_T fixed derived restriction [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. Let k_T:U_T E_TA^{-1}≅E_TB^{-1} V_T be the exact derived square of sfInverseRealizationRestriction and let c_T:E_TB U_T≅V_T E_TA be its forward conjugate by the realization units and counits [lem-finite-realization-mate-algebra]. Let d_A:E_ZA P_A≅Q_A E_YA and d_B:E_ZB P_B≅Q_B E_YB be sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison. Let h:U_Z P_A≅P_B U_Y be sfDerivedImageRestriction with the resolution normalization of [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars], and let t:V_Z Q_A≅Q_B V_Y be fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImage, the inverse mate of the exact restriction/pullback square. For every object L of the unbounded fixed-scalar B-category on Z, P_A(c_Z(L));d_A(V_Z L);E_YA(t_L)=h(E_ZB L);U_Y(d_B(L));c_Y(Q_B L). There is no scalar extension or change of site in this identity. No properness, noetherian, boundedness or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: First identify realizationRestrictionIso with mapDerivedCategorySquareIso of the section-normalized sfRealizationRestriction. Compute the ordinary inverse-realization mate directly from its definition, then apply exact derived adjunction mates. The mapped equivalence adjunction equals the specified derived equivalence adjunction, as follows from its counit normalization on localized complexes. Invert the unit equation, apply forward realization, use counit naturality, and cancel the equivalence triangle. This retains exactly the chosen units and counits.

Apply the proved ordinary cube. Its proof evaluates on sections after precomposing by the ordinary coefficient comparison. Invertibility of the realization unit reduces every section to a unit section, on which all four ordinary comparisons have their specified normalizations. The underlying sheafification units before and after scalar restriction agree.

Use the proved all-complex unit normalizations for the inverse intrinsic realization/direct-image comparisons and for the fixed-scalar inverse comparison. Together with the existing intrinsic restriction normalization and the ordinary cube, these are the four normalized squares required by the mixed-universe normalized-cube calculation. Cancellation then yields the inverse-direction derived cube.

Use the normalized cube calculation of DerivedExactSquareCoherence, reproved privately with independent derived-category Hom universes to accommodate fixed-scalar and intrinsic module categories simultaneously. Compose each pair of unit-normalized squares, apply naturality to the exact ordinary realization/restriction comparisons, and use their localization factors. This gives the inverse-direction cube. Cancel the inverse intrinsic restriction and direct-image realization isomorphisms, then substitute Step 1 to obtain the stated forward-direction equality. This argument also covers zero rings, zero complexes and empty schemes.

theorem realizationRestriction_directImage_cube
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (L : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)))) :
    (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g A).map
        ((realizationRestrictionIso φ Z).hom.app L) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison g A).hom.app
        ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars (ProEt.topology Z) φ.ulift).obj L) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).functor.map
        ((ProEtale.fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImage φ.ulift g).hom.app L) =
    (sfDerivedImageRestriction g φ).hom.app
        ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z B).functor.obj L) ≫
      (pbcDerivedRestrict (scalarRingMap φ Y)).map
        ((sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison g B).hom.app L) ≫
      (realizationRestrictionIso φ Y).hom.app
        ((ProEtale.lowerStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj L)
